title: Bollywood Actor Ranbir Kapoor Denies Starring in Dhoom 4
summary: Ranbir Kapoor has denied starring in the upcoming film Dhoom 4, stating he is only working on Ramayana and Love & War. The actor made this statement during a promotional event for Ramayana. Kapoor had been rumored to be part of Dhoom 4 for years, but he has now shut down these rumors.
summary_points: Ranbir Kapoor denied starring in Dhoom 4
He stated he is only working on Ramayana and Love & War
Kapoor made this statement during a promotional event for Ramayana
The actor had been rumored to be part of Dhoom 4 for years
title_hi: रणबीर कपूर ने धूम 4 में काम नहीं करने का दावा किया है
summary_hi: रणबीर कपूर ने धूम 4 में काम करने की खबरों पर चुप्पी तोड़ दी है. उन्होंने रामायण और लव एंड वॉर पर काम कर रहे हैं. कपूर ने इस बात का खुलासा रामायण के प्रमोशन के दौरान किया था.
